source_note: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位，Fejer核是逼近单位元
english_source_note: Dirichlet Kernels Fail, Fejer Kernels Approximate Identity
callout_id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#5
statement_en: If $f$ is an integrable function on the unit circle $\mathbb{T}$ and its Fourier coefficients satisfy $$\widehat{f}(n)=0,\forall n\in \mathbb{Z},$$ then at every point where $f$ is continuous, its value is $0$.
prerequisites: Fejer kernel as an approximate identity
callout_body: 如果函数$f$是单位圆周$\mathbb{T}$上的可积函数，并且其傅里叶系数满足$$\widehat{f}(n)=0,\forall n\in \mathbb{Z}$$那么在$f$的任意连续点处都为取值为0。
